bug_semantics: Authenticated IDOR / resource injection on POST /xxl-job-admin/joblog/getJobsByGroup: JobLogController.getJobsByGroup takes a client-supplied jobGroup integer and returns XxlJobInfo rows via xxlJobInfoDao.getJobsByGroup with no PermissionInterceptor.validJobGroupPermission check. Login is required by default (@PermissionLimit absent => needLogin=true, needAdminuser=false), but a non-admin whose permission string excludes that group can still enumerate group IDs and read job metadata for unauthorized executors. Sibling log APIs (pageList, index-when-jobId, clearLog) do call validJobGroupPermission, so the UI-filtered group list is not an enforcement boundary.
flaw_origin: The unguarded HTTP handler was first written on 2016-07-18 in 8a8d7a5caf0a65a384b296aaeda2d12d039d731d as @RequestMapping("/getJobsByGroup") listJobByGroup(String jobGroup) that passed the client identifier straight into xxlJobInfoDao.getJobsByGroup. git log -L on the 3.1.1 lines shows only later refactors (2017 type/rename to getJobsByGroup(int), 2025 @RequestParam). Executor-scoped authorization arrived in 7ccdd75d (2019-05-04) and 211abb985 (2019-05-08) added validPermission to pageList/index but never rewrote getJobsByGroup; a09f7f30 (2024-11-10) similarly guarded only clearLog. The identifier-lookup without group authorization therefore originates at the 2016 first write.
